newsitem.title: USA: New York bunker prices soften, Houston up.
newsitem.headline: New York bunker prices soften, Houston up.

text.p: U.S. bunker prices in New York Harbor softened early this week amid a fresh batch of resupply while players in the Gulf Coast tried to boost prices, players said on Tuesday.
In the Harbor, spot 380 CST fell $3 since last Thursday to between $96 a tonne and $98 a tonne, with 180 CST down to $102/$103.

"A lot of independents got some resupply and they got nervous carrying so much they began to sell it off," said an East Coast trader. He added the Harbor was also losing business to Rotterdam, which dropped $1/$2 tonne Tuesday.
Rotterdam bunkers were quoted at around $83/$84 as barges came off.

On the Gulf Coast, Houston 380 CST rose about $3 a tonne to $96/$98 a tonne as suppliers tried to push up prices. The weaker Harbor prices, however, put a lid on further substantial gains, traders said.
New York usually runs about a $10 premium to Houston.
The West Coast markets were mixed, with Los Angeles down about $1 a tonne from last Thursday and Seattle up amid slightly stronger inquiries.
Los Angeles 380 CST was pegged $105/106 a tonne and 180 CST was at about $110/$111 a tonne.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
